technology_name: Organo Clay from Waste Mica: Sustainable Pollution Control Material
problem_solved: Rising environmental contamination from heavy metals, dyes, and organic pollutants requires low-cost, eco-friendly remediation technologies.
description: Organo clay synthesized from waste mica and humic acid offers a sustainable solution for environmental pollution control. By functionalizing raw industrial mica waste with humic acid, the material's sorptive properties are significantly enhanced, enabling efficient removal of heavy metals, dyes, and organic pollutants. The mild, cost-effective synthesis process avoids hazardous chemicals. The resulting composite exhibits strong chelation and ion exchange properties, featuring a dual hydrophilic-hydrophobic character. It demonstrates excellent long-term structural stability and regeneration capabilities, allowing for multiple reuse cycles without significant performance loss.
applications:
• Wastewater treatment and purification for industrial and municipal effluent facilities

• Eco-friendly soil remediation of contaminated agricultural or brownfield sites

• Commercial manufacturing of low-cost environmental filtration materials

• Waste-to-resource valorization within the industrial mica mining sector
